title: Certified Phenom Instructor
lede: Twenty lessons and one exam over six weeks, about 30 hours in all, at your own pace.

weeks.title: Foundations
weeks.theme: Why it works, the tool, direct moves, the first boss

weeks.title: Borrowing and all 34
weeks.theme: Borrowing, all 34 moves, teaching the order

weeks.title: Running sessions
weeks.theme: Drill types, sessions and classes, bosses, the Bead Score

weeks.title: Multiply and divide, then the picture
Flash, stuck moments, and launch
weeks.theme: Flash, stuck moments, your first class, the test

lessons.title: Why this works, and what you may promise
lessons.lede: The lesson that lets you explain the method to any parent in two minutes, and never say a thing you cannot back up.
lessons.mirrors: Playbook chapters 1 and 3, and "The science, in plain words"

lessons.title: The abacus, the hand, reading and setting
lessons.lede: How the tool works, how the hand moves, and how a child learns to see a number on the beads in under three seconds.
lessons.mirrors: Stage 1 (Sprout) lessons "Hold it, clear it, move it", "Read any number", "Read hundreds in a glance", "Set numbers fast" and "Eyes closed"

lessons.title: Direct moves: when the beads are free
lessons.lede: The ground every one of the 34 moves stands on: adding when the beads are free, and taking away when the beads are there.
lessons.mirrors: Stage 1 lessons "Add when the beads are free" and "Take away when the beads are there"

lessons.title: Two columns, left to right, and the first boss
lessons.lede: Multi-digit problems run the way an abacus user runs them: set the first number, then add or take away each line, biggest place first.
lessons.mirrors: Stage 1 lesson "Two columns, left to right" and the Sprout Boss

lessons.title: Small friends, adding
lessons.lede: The first real technique: when you can't add a number directly, add five and take away its friend.
lessons.mirrors: Stage 2 (Explorer) lessons "+1 and +4: friends 1 and 4", "+2 and +3: friends 2 and 3" and "Small-friend adds in 2-digit numbers"

lessons.title: Small friends, taking away, and the Explorer boss
lessons.lede: The same four moves run backwards, all eight mixed, the first mental round, and the second boss.
lessons.mirrors: Stage 2 lessons "−1 and −4", "−2 and −3", "All eight friends, mixed", "Speed round", "Mental: three small numbers" and the Explorer Boss

lessons.title: Big friends: carrying
lessons.lede: When a number won't fit on the rod, take away its big friend and carry one to the left. The stage where the abacus starts beating paper.
lessons.mirrors: Stage 3 (Apprentice) lessons "+9, +8, +7", "+6 and +5", "+4, +3, +2, +1 past nine" and "Carry chains"

lessons.title: Big friends: borrowing, and the Apprentice boss
lessons.lede: Taking away a number that isn't there: add the big friend, then borrow one from the left. Then borrow chains, mixed problems and the first mental crossing of ten.
lessons.mirrors: Stage 3 lessons "−9, −8, −7: borrowing", "−6 down to −1", "Borrow chains and mixed problems", "Mental: small friends in the head", "Mental: crossing ten" and the Apprentice Boss

lessons.title: Both friends at once: all 34 moves
lessons.lede: The last eight moves, built from the first twenty-six. After this lesson, nothing new ever happens on a rod again.
lessons.mirrors: Stage 4 (Adept) lessons "Combo adds: 6+6, 7+7, 8+8, 5+9", "Combo take-aways: 11−6, 12−7, 13−8, 14−9", "All 34 formulas, mixed", "Three digits", "Ten rows" and the Adept Boss

lessons.title: Teaching the order, and the one question
lessons.lede: Why the 34 moves are taught in this order, how to tell when a child is ready for the next group, and the question that does the teaching for you.
lessons.mirrors: Stages 2 to 4 as a whole, and Playbook chapter 4 ("Why this order") and chapter 8 ("Why never the answer")

lessons.title: Drill types and tempo
lessons.lede: The five kinds of drill every proven abacus program uses, what each one builds, and how fast to read numbers to a child.
lessons.mirrors: the trainer's drill kinds (read, set, written, dictation, flash, mental) and Stage 5 lessons "Flash anzan begins" and "Listening: numbers read aloud"

lessons.title: Running a 15-minute session and a 45-minute class
lessons.lede: The daily home routine the trainer prints, the week it fits into, and a 45-minute group class built from the same parts.
lessons.mirrors: the trainer's daily routine and weekly rhythm, Stage 5 lessons "Fast hands" and "Read ahead", and the class plans in the Instructor Launch Kit

lessons.title: Boss tests, pass marks, and when to hold a child back
lessons.lede: How the ten boss tests work, how to read a failed part, and how to tell a parent "not yet" without losing the child.
lessons.mirrors: the boss test at the end of every stage in the trainer

lessons.title: The Bead Score and the kyu ladder
lessons.lede: The one number that measures the mental picture, how to give the test, and how the rungs line up with the Japanese exam grades.
lessons.mirrors: Stage 5 lesson "Your first Bead Score", the Bead Score and Times ladders and Playbook chapter 7

lessons.title: Multiplication on the beads
lessons.lede: Times tables plus adding: every small product is two digits, and its right-hand digit lands in the column of its place value.
lessons.mirrors: Stage 6 (Wizard) lessons "Times tables: the spell book", "2-digit × 1-digit", "3-digit × 1-digit", "2-digit × 2-digit", "Mental: 2-digit × 1-digit", "3-digit × 2-digit", "Keep the mental beads warm" and the Wizard Boss

lessons.title: Division on the beads
lessons.lede: Multiplication run backwards: guess a digit, multiply, take away, repeat. Everything the child needs is already in their hands.
lessons.mirrors: Stage 7 (Champion) lessons "Divide 2-digit by 1-digit", "Divide 3-digit by 1-digit", "Remainders", "Divide by 2-digit numbers", "Mental: divide by 1-digit", "Mental: three 3-digit numbers", "Flash: 2-digit numbers" and the Champion Boss

lessons.title: Anzan: building the picture
lessons.lede: How the mental abacus grows from one rod to three or four, why it stops there, and what to do when it collapses.
lessons.mirrors: the mental lessons across the stages: Stage 1 "Eyes closed", Stage 2 "Mental: three small numbers", Stage 3 "Mental: crossing ten", Stage 4 "Mental: five single digits", "two 2-digit numbers" and "three 2-digit numbers", Stage 5 "Mental: five 2-digit numbers", Stage 7 "Mental: three 3-digit numbers", Stage 8 "Mental: ten 3-digit lines" and Stage 9 "Mental: 4-digit lines"

lessons.title: Flash anzan: tempos and the kyu table
lessons.lede: The drill that convinces every grandparent: numbers that appear and vanish, and only the total stays.
lessons.mirrors: Stage 5 "Flash anzan begins" and "Flash: faster, longer", Stage 7 "Flash: 2-digit numbers", Stage 8 "Flash: 3-digit numbers" and "Flash: ten 3-digit numbers", Stage 9 and 10 flash lessons, and Playbook chapter 6

lessons.title: Common mistakes, and what to say
lessons.lede: How to read a mistake from the size of the miss, and the short lines that get a child unstuck without ever giving the answer.
lessons.mirrors: Playbook chapter 8 ("What to say when they get stuck") and the trainer's stuck help and parent lines

lessons.title: Your first class, the test, and the Launch Kit
lessons.lede: How the certification test works, what the Launch Kit gives you, and how to run your first class without making a single promise you can't keep.
lessons.mirrors: the certification exam, the Instructor Launch Kit and the Pass Promise
